user.title: User
user.description: User profile, configuration, and premium status

uid.description: The unique Firebase Auth user ID

customApiKey.description: User-supplied API key if they want to use their own

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: A conversation thread session created by a user

id.description: A unique identifier for the conversation session

title.description: Aggregated or custom title of the chat

userId.description: The owner user ID who created this chat

modelType.description: The style of model chosen (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or Dola)

assistantType.description: The current persona mode (e.g. general, coding, study)

message.title: Message
message.description: An indexable chat message in a specific conversation

chatId.description: Association pointer to parents chat document

userId.description: User creator UID or system bot string

reasoning.description: Optional Thinking response text from the model for Think Mode

imageUrl.description: Optional inline image url base64/hosting if sent with message

users/{userId}.description: Top-level collection for storing user profiles and custom API key configuration.

chats/{chatId}.description: Collection tracking separate chat sessions per user.

chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Subcollection under each chat session document keeping messages sequentially ordered.
